name: Apache CouchDB
summary: CouchDB expressly forbids contributing material generated by AI, LLMs or similar tools anywhere in the project, including source code, documentation, commit messages and all other areas. The stated reason is that AI tools cannot guarantee Apache 2 licence compatibility or proper attribution of the work.

evidence.quote: Thus, it is expressly forbidden to contribute material generated by AI, LLMs, and similar technologies, to the CouchDB project. This includes, but is not limited to, source code, documentation, commit messages, or any other areas of the project.

AI and LLMs, by their nature, are unable to provide the necessary assurance, that the generated material is compatible with the Apache 2 license, or that the material has been appropriately attributed to the original authors.
